identification: Heavy hand-blown sculptural 'bird/horn' centrepiece bowl, about 20 cm high: two flared ribbed lobes rising from a solid uranium (vaseline) green core, cased in clear glass, rims shading to amber/honey, on a thick round clear-and-green foot. Optic-ribbed walls. Style is mid-century Czech (Bohemian) art glass of the 1960s-70s, the type attributed to Josef Hospodka for Chribska glassworks or Prachen/Sklo Union; Murano Sommerso is the other possibility.

viewing_check: Look under the foot for a polished pontil, acid stamp or foil label (Chribska, Sklo Union, Bohemia Glass or Murano). Check both lobe rims and the foot edge for chips or flea bites. UV torch to confirm the green core glows. Check weight: heavy solid casting points to Czech or Murano rather than cheap imports.
